local_only.approve: lands a branch through gh pr, an archive-tag push and a branch delete; the cloud's GitHub proxy refuses all three
local_only.approve-pr: approves as the repo's reviewer account, whose gh token only the Mac has; gh pr is refused in the cloud
local_only.archive-tag: pushes an archive/ tag; the cloud's GitHub proxy refuses tag pushes
local_only.collect-docs: surveys other repositories through gh api; the cloud answers 403 for a repository not attached to the session
local_only.daily-log: writes the journal under ~/Documents and runs from launchd, both on the Mac
local_only.herdr: drives Herdr panes, which run on the Mac
local_only.merge-pr: merges through gh pr, which the cloud refuses (GraphQL)
local_only.open-pr: opens the PR through gh pr, which the cloud refuses (GraphQL); a cloud session has its own Create PR
local_only.portable-plugin: trial-installs in codex, pi and agy, which the cloud lacks, and releases by a tag push
local_only.prune-branch: deletes the branch on origin, which the cloud's GitHub proxy refuses
local_only.push-branch: its preflight runs gh repo view (GraphQL), which the cloud refuses; a cloud session pushes its own branch
local_only.ship: opens its PR through gh pr and finishes a worktree that ai-dotfiles worktree new made on the Mac
local_only.worktree-guard: a cloud session already works alone on its own claude/ branch; the guard's records live on the Mac
